description: Source code for the 'Location' doctype in ERPNext, handling geographic features, area calculations, and hierarchical location management.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a geographic location with hierarchical and spatial features, extending NestedSet for tree structure management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the location, calculates area, and updates ancestor features if necessary.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles post-update actions, invoking NestedSet's on_update.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a location is deleted, including validation and ancestor updates.

methods.name: calculate_location_area
methods.description: Calculates and updates the geographic area of the location based on features.

methods.name: get_location_features
methods.description: Retrieves GeoJSON features from the location's stored data.

methods.name: set_location_features
methods.description: Sets the location's features data and updates the database.

methods.name: update_ancestor_location_features
methods.description: Updates features and area of ancestor locations based on current location.

methods.name: remove_ancestor_location_features
methods.description: Removes current location's features from ancestors and updates their areas.

methods.name: add_child_property
methods.description: Adds 'child_feature' property to features for hierarchical distinction.

methods.name: feature_seperator
methods.description: Separates features into child and non-child based on 'feature_of' property.
